verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm, and user-defined event-triggered automation rules are not a fair question when comparing legal service providers. Its client tools (Contract Generator, GDHQ, SMART Request intake forms, the D&O Questionnaire Portal, and the attorney-only ChatGD) are document and intake utilities, and nothing in the evidence shows any rules or trigger engine that would make this axis apply. The "acceleration triggers" mentioned are legal terms in equity agreements, not software automation.
